description: Remove a solid or near-solid background by flood-filling from the border. color is an optional #rrggbb. The portrait model runs in the browser, not in this handler: MODNet is Apache-2.0, RMBG-1.4 is non-commercial, and the ONNX runtime is too large for the serverless function. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the decoded file is capped at 10 MB. Returns a PNG as base64.

color.description: Background color as #rgb or #rrggbb. Blank samples the corners.

file.description: The image. Provide url or data.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

tolerance.description: How far a border pixel may be from the background color, in RGB distance.

name: remove_background
title: Remove a solid image background
